_comment: The client overlay. This is the layer that carries
client-identifying material: the Jira evidence rules, kb/testing/<project>/,
and the real config/client-overlay.json that core skills read.
It exists as a separate profile precisely so a team that is not this client
never installs any of it. The client specifics were taken out of the three
core skills so this overlay is the only place they live.
